text: KKCG took over the remaining shares of Sazka, becoming its owner; Sazka Group rebranded to Allwyn International in May 2022.
short: KKCG owns Allwyn (ex-Sazka Group), rebranded May 2022.

source.name: Wikipedia – Allwyn Entertainment
source.quote: One year later, KKCG took over the remaining shares of Sazka a.s., effectively becoming its owner.

additionalSources.name: Wikipedia – Allwyn Entertainment
additionalSources.quote: Sazka Group a.s. completed its rebranding to Allwyn International a.s. in May 2022.
